_readme: Residential electricity rates for the Caribbean cost pages. Edit a country's rate, date and source here and every Caribbean page updates. localRate is per kWh in the local currency; usdRate is the same in US dollars at the source's exchange rate. Rates include fuel charges and taxes unless noted.

countries.name: Bahamas
countries.source: BPL residential tariff and fuel charge on a September 2026 household bill (1,505 kWh; energy and fuel charges, before fixed charges and taxes)
countries.note: BPL bills residential energy in tiers, plus a fuel charge that is a direct pass-through of fuel costs. On a September 2026 bill: no energy charge on the first 200 kWh, 11.95¢/kWh from 201 to 800 kWh and 14.95¢ above 800, plus a fuel charge of 17.4¢/kWh on the first 800 kWh and 21.4¢ above that. So every kWh above 800 a month (usually the air conditioning) costs 36.35¢ before fixed charges and taxes, more than the 31.0¢ average shown here.

countries.name: Jamaica
countries.source: GlobalPetrolPrices.com, household electricity price (includes fuel charge, taxes and fees)
countries.note: JPS bills include a fuel and purchased-power charge that is adjusted monthly, so the effective rate moves with world fuel prices.

countries.name: Barbados
countries.source: GlobalPetrolPrices.com, household electricity price (includes fuel charge, taxes and fees)
countries.note: BL&P's domestic base energy charge rises with usage (BBD 0.160/kWh for the first 150 kWh up to BBD 0.254 above 1,500 kWh), and a fuel clause adjustment that changes monthly is added to every kWh.

countries.name: Trinidad and Tobago
countries.source: GlobalPetrolPrices.com, household electricity price (includes taxes and fees)
countries.note: Trinidad and Tobago generates its power from domestic natural gas, which is why its rates are among the lowest in the Caribbean.

countries.name: Cayman Islands
countries.source: GlobalPetrolPrices.com, household electricity price (includes fuel cost charge, taxes and fees)
countries.note: Fuel costs rose in 2026: CUC bills sent in July 2026 were about CI$50 higher for the average household using 1,158 kWh a month, roughly CI$0.04/kWh more than before, even after a government fuel-relief credit.

countries.name: Bermuda
countries.source: GlobalPetrolPrices.com, household electricity price (includes fuel adjustment, taxes and fees)
countries.note: Bermuda is subtropical rather than tropical, so most homes run air conditioning from late spring to early autumn rather than year-round.

countries.name: Puerto Rico
countries.source: Puerto Rico Energy Bureau quarterly adjustment, as reported by El Nuevo Día (Oct. 1, 2026)
countries.note: The Energy Bureau resets fuel and purchased-power charges every quarter. The October–December 2026 rate is a record high for residential customers.

countries.name: Dominican Republic
countries.source: GlobalPetrolPrices.com, household electricity price (includes taxes and fees)
countries.note: Dominican residential tariffs are set by the government and rise in steps with monthly usage, so households running AC heavily pay a higher rate on their top block than the average shown here.
